sections.title: Aerospace Supply Chain Monitoring Agents
sections.description: For Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton) and ULA (Centennial) and their commercial supplier ecosystems.

blocks.heading: Supplier performance monitoring agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents tracking the on-time delivery, quality performance, and financial health of the aerospace supply chains serving Denver's Space Corridor — generating early warnings when supplier metrics approach risk thresholds before delivery disruptions occur.

blocks.heading: AS9100 certification monitoring agents
paragraphs: Agents tracking certification expiration, audit outcomes, and CAR (Corrective Action Request) closure status across the supplier networks of Lockheed's and ULA's commercial programs.

blocks.heading: Space weather and launch opportunity agents
paragraphs: Agents monitoring space weather forecasts, orbital launch window calculations, and FAA commercial launch permit status for ULA's commercial satellite launch operations.
Self-hosted deployment standard for aerospace data.

sections.title: Energy Regulatory Monitoring Agents
sections.description: For Xcel Energy (Denver HQ) and Colorado's utility and oil and gas community.

blocks.heading: FERC and NERC compliance agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents tracking FERC rulemaking, NERC reliability standards updates, and Colorado PUC regulatory proceedings relevant to Xcel's transmission and distribution operations — synthesizing regulatory developments into structured compliance review items for Xcel's regulatory affairs team.

blocks.heading: Renewable interconnection monitoring agents
paragraphs: Agents tracking the status of solar and wind interconnection requests in CAISO and MISO queues for the Colorado renewable energy development community — critical for project developers managing multiple interconnection applications simultaneously.

blocks.heading: Colorado COGCC compliance agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents monitoring Colorado Oil and Gas Conservation Commission regulations for the Denver Basin and DJ Basin operators — tracking permit requirements, spill reporting obligations, and production reporting deadlines.

blocks.heading: Colorado payer PA coordination agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents coordinating prior authorization for Colorado's specific payer mix (Anthem Colorado, Cigna Colorado, Aetna Colorado, UnitedHealth CO, Rocky Mountain Health Plans, Colorado Medicaid) — each payer's PA portal, clinical criteria, and submission requirements differ, creating coordination complexity that agents can navigate more reliably than staff-only workflows.

blocks.heading: Post-acute care coordination agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents coordinating post-discharge care transitions for UCHealth's high-risk patients — scheduling follow-up appointments, arranging home health, and monitoring medication adherence in the 30 days following discharge.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act-compliant healthcare agents
paragraphs: Healthcare agents in Colorado that make or support high-risk automated decisions must comply with Colorado's SB24-205 AI Act — ClickMasters designs Denver healthcare agents with Colorado AI Act impact assessment documentation.

blocks.heading: MED (Marijuana Enforcement Division) compliance agents
paragraphs: Autonomous agents monitoring compliance requirements for Colorado's licensed cannabis cultivators, processors, and retailers — tracking seed-to-sale reporting requirements, license renewal deadlines, and MED inspection preparation.

blocks.heading: Cannabis regulatory change monitoring agents
paragraphs: Agents tracking Colorado's evolving cannabis regulations, potency limits, packaging requirements, and local jurisdiction restrictions for the large cannabis company operators managing multi-location compliance.

sections.title: Denver's AI agent market uniqueness
sections.description: Denver's AI agent market has several characteristics that distinguish it from other major US markets.

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act as agent design driver
paragraphs: Colorado's SB24-205 AI Act — one of the first comprehensive US state AI regulation laws — creates specific design requirements for AI agents making consequential automated decisions. Healthcare and insurance agents in Colorado must include impact assessments and consumer disclosures that agents in most other US states don't currently require. ClickMasters designs all Denver high-risk AI agents with Colorado AI Act compliance from the first architecture decision.

blocks.heading: Legal cannabis compliance as unique agent market
paragraphs: Colorado's legal cannabis industry is the most mature in the US — and the Metrc seed-to-sale tracking system and Colorado Marijuana Enforcement Division's regulatory framework create compliance AI demand that exists only in legal cannabis states. Denver's cannabis tech community is building the compliance infrastructure tools that other states will adopt as cannabis legalization expands nationally.

blocks.heading: Space industry agent applications
paragraphs: The Space Corridor's commercial space activity — including the growing smallsat and NewSpace community at Colorado companies beyond just Lockheed and ULA — creates AI agent demand for autonomous satellite operations monitoring, space weather tracking, and commercial launch coordination that is genuinely frontier territory for AI agents.
